canDoYue: 你識比較預繳同無限計劃，仲識開通電話卡。
canDoEn: Compare a prepaid plan with an unlimited plan, then activate a SIM.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Hello. I need a new SIM card and a bigger data plan.
dialogue.glossYue: 你好。我需要一張新電話卡，同埋大啲嘅數據計劃。
dialogue.say: Hello. I need a new SIM card and a bigger data plan.

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.text: Which phone plan is better for a short city trip?
dialogue.glossYue: 邊個電話計劃適合市區短途？
dialogue.say: Which phone plan is better for a short city trip?

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.text: The prepaid plan is much cheaper, and the coverage is enough.
dialogue.glossYue: 預繳計劃平好多，覆蓋都夠。
dialogue.say: The prepaid plan is much cheaper, and the coverage is enough.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I'll take the cheaper prepaid plan for this short trip.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢次短途我要平啲嗰個預繳計劃。
dialogue.say: I'll take the cheaper prepaid plan for this short trip.

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.text: Please activate the new SIM card with your valid passport.
dialogue.glossYue: 請用你本有效護照開通呢張新電話卡。
dialogue.say: Please activate the new SIM card with your valid passport.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Is the unlimited plan locked on a long phone contract?
dialogue.glossYue: 無限計劃係咪綁一份長電話合約？
dialogue.say: Is the unlimited plan locked on a long phone [[ˈkɑntɹækt]]?

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.text: A small top-up is enough if the data stays low.
dialogue.glossYue: 數據用得少，少少增值就夠。
dialogue.say: A small top-up is enough if the data stays low.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I will pay for this cheaper prepaid plan here.
dialogue.glossYue: 我喺呢度畀錢買呢個平啲嘅預繳計劃。
dialogue.say: I will pay for this cheaper prepaid plan here.
